# UpTrend Scaling

> Google review automation for local businesses. Automatically asks customers for a Google review by SMS and email the moment a job is finished, sends one follow-up reminder, and offers QR codes for in-person requests.

UpTrend Scaling is a small, owner-operated software company based in Glendale, Arizona, founded in September 2026. It is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.uptrendscaling.com/): what it does, how it works, pricing, and frequently asked questions.
- Pricing: $70/month per location, plus a one-time $20 setup fee. 7-day free trial, nothing charged until it ends. Month-to-month, cancel anytime.
- Who it's for: local, customer-facing businesses such as home services, auto sales and service, restaurants and cafés, salons and spas, medical and dental practices, and retail or specialty shops.
- [Start a free trial](https://www.uptrendscaling.com/start)
